title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The government has released a response to a report about Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards. This response outlines the government's plans to address key issues raised in the report, aiming to develop and implement standards related to AI in the public sector.

title: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) in education
description: The Department for Education’s (DfE) position on the use of generative AI in the education sector.
summary: The Department for Education has a position on the use of generative AI in schools. The exact details of this policy are not provided in the title.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: Ofqual's policy document outlines their approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in the qualifications sector. The policy aims to address concerns from several government departments regarding AI's impact.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This report assesses the impact of using copyrighted works to develop artificial intelligence systems. It likely explores the rights and responsibilities surrounding the creation of AI with copyrighted data or content.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The UK government has responded to a report by the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence, acknowledging the potential risks and opportunities of AI technology. The government aims to address these issues with no complacency and ensure responsible AI development in the UK.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: This policy document establishes the Terms of Reference and Frequently Asked Questions for a review committee that will examine the relationship between artificial intelligence and public standards. The committee's review aims to provide a framework and guidance on how artificial intelligence interacts with public standards.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: The CSPL (Committee on Standards in Public Life) has shared its views with the UK's Science and Technology Committee about how to govern Artificial Intelligence. The submission aims to inform the Committee's inquiry on the subject.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This policy document explores and discusses the potential impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) on the regulation of medical products. It aims to implement the principles outlined in the AI White Paper to better handle this emerging technology in the medical product regulation field.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The UK Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the Defence organisation the most effective, efficient, trusted, and influential in its size. It has a vision to achieve this by leveraging artificial intelligence in its operations and decision-making processes.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: The Transport artificial intelligence action plan is a policy document that outlines how the Department for Transport (DfT) will make the most of artificial intelligence in transport while minimizing potential risks. It also describes how the DfT will work with the transport sector on this goal.
